# ElectroMart

> ElectroMart is an electronics e-commerce store offering laptops, desktops, printers, PC components (CPU, GPU, RAM, motherboard, power supply, cabinet), peripherals, and more with fast delivery across India, GST invoicing, and B2B bulk sourcing.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://06037w7q-5500.inc1.devtunnels.ms/): Storefront with featured deals, top-rated and recommended products.

- [Laptops](https://06037w7q-5500.inc1.devtunnels.ms/laptop.html): Work, gaming, and creator-ready laptops.
- [Computers / Desktops](https://06037w7q-5500.inc1.devtunnels.ms/desktops.html): Performance desktop builds.
- [Printers](https://06037w7q-5500.inc1.devtunnels.ms/printer.html): Home and office printers.
- [PC Builder](https://06037w7q-5500.inc1.devtunnels.ms/pc-builder.html): Custom PC configuration tool.
- [Today's Deals](https://06037w7q-5500.inc1.devtunnels.ms/todays-deals.html): Limited-time discounts and offers.
- [Best Sellers](https://06037w7q-5500.inc1.devtunnels.ms/best-sellers.html): Most-purchased products now.
